core/tokens/starfield/textures.ts

CDN URLs for the Star Field experiment texture set —
Source src/core/tokens/starfield/textures.ts
UX surface Shared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

_SF_TEX

CDN root the Star Field texture set uploads under.

SF_TEXTURES

CDN URLs for the full Star Field texture set — sole declaration site; consumers import members rather than re-declaring the literals.

IO

Moons — NASA-3D-Resources equirect global mosaics (Galileo/Cassini/ Voyager basemaps). 1440×720 is the highest public distribution for most of these bodies; Phobos upgrades to the 5499px USGS map.

CERES

Dwarf planets / small bodies — Ceres is the Dawn HAMO elliptical map (PIA20351, 4000px); Vesta the GeoHack Dawn mosaic; Phobos the USGS 5499px map above; Bennu the 8k OSIRIS-REx-derived albedo; Ryugu the ONC albedo map. Asteroid albedos are grayscale — honest to the data.

NEBULA_CARINA

Real-photography billboards — NASA/Hubble/ESA imagery on the deep-sky bodies (nebulae, star clusters, external galaxies). All served from the CDN bucket; additive/masked compositing hides the rectangular edge so the photo reads as the object.

SF_DATA_BASE

Public-URL prefix for the per-body lazy-loaded JSON dossiers.

SF_ASSET_BASE

Module public-asset root — dossier media entries join under this.
